blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.pricePreference` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method retrieves a price preference. It sends a request to the
[Get Price Preference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#price-preferences\_getpricepreferencesid)
API route.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the price preference.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: price_preference
children.description: The price preference's details.

children.name: id
children.description: The price preference's ID.

children.name: attribute
children.description:
The attribute that the price preference refers to.

Current supported values: `region_id` and `currency_code`.

children.name: value
children.description:
The attribute's value. For example, if the `attribute` is `region_id`,
the value is a region's ID. Prices in that region use this price
preference.

children.name: is_tax_inclusive
children.description:
Whether prices matching this price preference have
taxes included in their amount.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date that the price preference was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date that the price preference was updated.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The date that the price preference was deleted.
